name: gradle
description: Gradle build automation tool for JVM projects with dependency management, multi-project builds, and Kotlin/Groovy DSL support

gradle.description: Gradle build automation — task graph execution, dependency resolution, multi-project orchestration, incremental builds, and build cache
gradle.usage:
gradle build # Compile, test, and assemble
gradle clean build # Clean rebuild
gradle dependencies # Print dependency tree
gradle tasks # List available tasks
gradle test --tests 'com.foo.BarTest' # Run filtered tests
gradle assemble -x test # Assemble skipping tests
gradle :module:build # Build a specific subproject
gradle --refresh-dependencies build # Force re-resolve dependencies
gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.14.1 # Pin wrapper version
